thread:
tom (Accounting): FYI received invoice 2026-04-10 SL-3321 from Skyline Tech for $11,200, PDF has no PO. AP auto-match failed, holding payment.
sara (Procurement): uploaded invoice SL-3321.pdf to ticketing. running PO lookup...
sara (Procurement): found PO-802410 for Skyline from 2026-01-08 amount $10,000 (annual infra services). invoice amount > PO by $1,200.
cecilia (Eng Ops): that $1,200 looks like a month of extra reserved capacity. did we approve burst capacity in March?
cecilia (Eng Ops): we did approve on-call burst but only up to $800 via Slack confirmation thread on 2026-03-12. nothing for $1,200.
own (Vendor Relations): Skyline says the extra is "emergency scaling" during a one-off incident. vendor rep suggests issuing a credit for $200 and re-issuing invoice for $11,000 referencing PO-802410.
tom (Accounting): AP policy: invoice must reference PO to pay. If amount differs, need PO amendment or manager approval with comment.
sara (Procurement): options: (1) ask vendor to reissue invoice matching PO and accept $1,200 dispute, (2) create amendment PO-802410-AMD for $1,200 and route to approver, (3) partial payment for the $10,000 and dispute $1,200.
cecilia (Eng Ops): i'd rather not pay disputed amount until we confirm incident scope. can we get incident logs and cost breakdown from Skyline?
own (Vendor Relations): requesting itemized usage and timestamps now. ticket V-1165 opened. vendor offered 2% early-pay discount if we accept full invoice and pay within 7 days.
tom (Accounting): hold created in AP: HOLD-2099. due date on invoice 2026-05-10. with early-pay discount, net would be $10,976 — still more than PO.
sara (Procurement): approver for infra spend >$10k is cecilia per delegation. cecilia, please confirm whether to (A) approve amendment for $1,200, (B) accept vendor credit then match to PO, or (C) route to finance director for exception.
cecilia (Eng Ops): i'll review usage docs when vendor replies. tentatively approve vendor credit + reissue referencing PO. that keeps audit clean.
own (Vendor Relations): vendor acknowledged, will send itemized usage and prepare credit note for $1,200 if confirmed.
ap-bot: Reminder — invoices on hold must be reviewed within 10 business days to avoid auto-escalation.
tom (Accounting): thanks. leaving hold. will update thread when vendor sends docs or when procurement creates amendment. :white_check_mark:
